about: Editorial calls from Afronomics Receipts, written when each Receipt is published and graded against the source each call names. Never edited: a correction is a new call. The outcome is the published figure, with its source and quote.

calls.statement: The offer clears its 75% minimum and the shares list on 12 November 2026
calls.measure: Shares listed on the NSE on 12 November 2026
calls.check_source: Results announcement; NSE

calls.statement: Total demand comes in below 150% of the shares on offer
calls.measure: Total demand, % of the shares on offer
calls.check_source: Results announcement

calls.statement: The shares close their first trading day within 10% of KES 7.50
calls.measure: First-day NSE closing price
calls.check_source: NSE closing price

calls.statement: Profit for 2026 comes in below the KES 2.1 billion forecast
calls.measure: Profit for 2026
calls.check_source: Audited 2026 results

calls.statement: Trade payable days at 31 December 2026 are above 77
calls.measure: Trade payable days at 31 December 2026
calls.check_source: Audited 2026 results

calls.statement: Kenyan applications for the receipts come in below the KES 39 billion target
calls.measure: Kenyan GDR applications received
calls.check_source: Renaissance Capital (Kenya) allotment announcement

calls.statement: The shares are listed on the Nigerian Exchange by 18 December 2026
calls.measure: Shares listed on the NGX by 18 December 2026
calls.check_source: NGX listing notice

calls.statement: The receipts start trading on the NSE by 31 December 2026
calls.measure: Dangote GDRs trading on the NSE by 31 December 2026
calls.check_source: NSE listing notice

calls.statement: Profit for 2026 comes in below US$3.64 billion, twice the first half
calls.measure: Profit after tax for 2026
calls.check_source: Audited 2026 financial statements

calls.statement: Kenya's 2031 Eurobond yields less than 9% on 31 March 2027
calls.measure: Yield on Kenya's 2031 Eurobond for 31 March 2027, CBK Weekly Bulletin Table 6
calls.check_source: CBK Weekly Bulletin, Table 6 (Afronomics Eurobond file)

calls.statement: Kenya's 2031 Eurobond still yields more than Nigeria's January 2031 Eurobond on 31 March 2027
calls.measure: Kenya 2031 yield minus Nigeria 8.747% January 2031 yield on 31 March 2027, in points
calls.check_source: CBK Weekly Bulletin Table 6 and Nigeria DMO daily Eurobond prices (Afronomics Eurobond file)

calls.statement: Kenya pays the 16 February 2027 coupon on the 2031 notes, US$73.125 million, on the due date
calls.measure: 16 February 2027 coupon on the 9.750% notes due 2031 paid on the due date
calls.check_source: National Treasury, monthly public debt bulletin for February 2027

calls.statement: Kenya's next new dollar Eurobond carries a coupon below the 9.75% of the 2031 notes
calls.measure: Coupon of the first new Kenya US-dollar Eurobond priced between 15 October 2026 and 30 June 2027 (void if none is priced)
calls.check_source: National Treasury pricing press release

calls.statement: No infrastructure bond, new or reopened, clears at a weighted average rate above 15% at any auction before 30 June 2027
calls.measure: Highest weighted average rate accepted at any IFB auction, 16 October 2026 to 30 June 2027
calls.check_source: CBK Treasury bond auction results (Afronomics bond auction file)

calls.statement: The 364-day Treasury bill clears below 10% at the last auction of June 2027
calls.measure: 364-day bill weighted average rate, last auction with a value date in June 2027
calls.check_source: CBK Treasury bill auction results (Afronomics auction file)

calls.statement: Any new infrastructure bond issued before 31 December 2027 carries a coupon below 14%
calls.measure: Highest coupon on a new IFB issued between 16 October 2026 and 31 December 2027
calls.check_source: CBK Treasury bond auction results (Afronomics bond auction file)

calls.statement: The Affordable Housing Board's 2025/26 annual report counts fewer than 20,000 completed housing units
calls.measure: Housing units reported complete in the Affordable Housing Board's annual report and financial statements for the year ended 30 June 2026
calls.check_source: Affordable Housing Board, annual report and financial statements 2025/26 (tabled in Parliament with the Auditor-General's report)

calls.statement: Housing Levy collected in 2025/26 is below KES 90 billion
calls.measure: Affordable Housing Levy revenue for the year ended 30 June 2026, Affordable Housing Fund audited financial statements
calls.check_source: Affordable Housing Fund, annual report and financial statements 2025/26 (Auditor-General)

calls.statement: The levy is still 1.5% of gross salary for the employee, matched by the employer, on 30 June 2027
calls.measure: Rate in section 4(2) of the Affordable Housing Act in force on 30 June 2027
calls.check_source: Affordable Housing Act on Kenya Law

calls.statement: The Sacco Societies (Amendment) Bill, 2025 is still not law on 30 June 2027
calls.measure: Bill No. 32 of 2025 assented to and published as an Act on or before 30 June 2027
calls.check_source: Kenya Gazette and Kenya Law, Acts of 2026 and 2027

calls.statement: No date is set for the SACCO Deposit Guarantee Fund to start paying claims before 31 December 2027
calls.measure: A date for the start of payments of claims from the SACCO Deposit Guarantee Fund, appointed and published on or before 31 December 2027
calls.check_source: Kenya Gazette; SASRA notices and annual reports

calls.statement: Deposits in regulated SACCOs reach at least KES 920 billion at 31 December 2026
calls.measure: Total deposits of all regulated SACCOs (DT and NWDT) at 31 December 2026
calls.check_source: SASRA Quarterly Statistical and Soundness Report, December 2026 (Afronomics SACCO file)

calls.statement: The CBK rate is between KES 125 and KES 135 to the US dollar on 31 March 2027
calls.measure: CBK indicative mean rate, KES per US dollar, for 31 March 2027 (or the last working day before it), CBK Weekly Bulletin Table 1
calls.check_source: CBK Weekly Bulletin, Table 1, Kenya Shilling Exchange Rates

calls.statement: The shilling is weaker on 31 March 2027 than its 8 October 2026 rate of KES 129.94
calls.measure: CBK indicative mean rate, KES per US dollar, for 31 March 2027 (or the last working day before it)
calls.check_source: CBK Weekly Bulletin, Table 1, Kenya Shilling Exchange Rates

calls.statement: CBK foreign exchange reserves still cover at least five months of imports in the last Weekly Bulletin of March 2027
calls.measure: CBK foreign exchange reserves, months of import cover, latest date in the last Weekly Bulletin published in March 2027 (Table 2)
calls.check_source: CBK Weekly Bulletin, Table 2, Foreign Exchange Reserves

calls.statement: The 364-day Treasury bill clears between 8% and 10% at the last auction with a value date in March 2027
calls.measure: 364-day bill weighted average rate of accepted bids, last auction with a value date in March 2027
calls.check_source: CBK Treasury bill auction results (Afronomics auction file)

calls.statement: The Central Bank Rate is at or below 8.75% after the last MPC meeting held before 30 June 2027
calls.measure: Central Bank Rate announced at the last MPC meeting held before 30 June 2027
calls.check_source: CBK MPC press release

calls.statement: Kenyan money market funds hold more than the KES 459.9 billion they held at 30 June 2026 when the CMA reports 31 December 2026
calls.measure: Total of the Money Market Funds table, CMA Collective Investment Schemes report for Q4 2026
calls.check_source: CMA Collective Investment Schemes quarterly report, Q4 2026 (Afronomics money market fund size file)

calls.statement: Interest on government securities is still at least a quarter of Kenyan banks' total income in 2026
calls.measure: Interest on government securities as a share of total income, banking sector, year to December 2026 (CBK Bank Supervision Annual Report 2026, income table)
calls.check_source: CBK, Bank Supervision Annual Report 2026

calls.statement: Growth in bank lending to the private sector is at least 8% in December 2026
calls.measure: Growth in commercial banks' lending to the private sector, December 2026, year on year, as reported by the CBK
calls.check_source: CBK, Monetary Policy Committee press release or Monthly Economic Indicators covering December 2026

calls.statement: Banks' average lending rate is still above 13% in December 2026
calls.measure: Commercial banks' weighted average lending rate, December 2026
calls.check_source: CBK, commercial banks' weighted average rates (Afronomics rates file)

calls.statement: Fuliza disbursements grow again in Safaricom's year to March 2027, above the KES 1,465.8 billion of FY26
calls.measure: Fuliza value of disbursements (KShs Bn), FY27, Safaricom FY27 results booklet
calls.check_source: Safaricom PLC, FY27 Results Booklet, Financial Services: Lending table

calls.statement: The average Fuliza draw keeps shrinking: below KES 217.9 in the year to March 2027
calls.measure: Fuliza Average Ticket Size (KShs), FY27, Safaricom FY27 results booklet
calls.check_source: Safaricom PLC, FY27 Results Booklet, Financial Services: Lending table

calls.statement: Safaricom's published total daily Fuliza charge on a KES 501 to 1,000 balance is still KES 6 on 31 March 2027
calls.measure: Total Charges for the 501-1000 band in the Fuliza tariff table on Safaricom's Fuliza page, 31 March 2027
calls.check_source: Safaricom, Fuliza page (charges and tariff table)

calls.statement: Kenya Airways still reports negative total equity at 31 December 2026
calls.measure: Group total equity at 31 December 2026, Kenya Airways audited results for 2026
calls.check_source: Kenya Airways PLC, summary audited group results for the year ended 31 December 2026

calls.statement: Kenya Airways' loss after tax for 2026 is bigger than 2025's KES 17.2 billion
calls.measure: Group loss after tax for the year ended 31 December 2026, as a positive number
calls.check_source: Kenya Airways PLC, summary audited group results for the year ended 31 December 2026

calls.statement: The conversion of about KES 122 billion of government loans is not completed by 30 June 2027
calls.measure: Kenya Airways announcement, through the NSE, that the conversion of existing government loans has been completed, published by 30 June 2027
calls.check_source: Kenya Airways PLC announcements on the NSE and USE

calls.statement: Money from North America in October 2026 is below October 2025's
calls.measure: North America inflows, October 2026 against October 2025, % change, CBK Diaspora Remittances table (monthly inflows by source)
calls.check_source: CBK, Diaspora Remittances page (monthly inflows by source); CBK Weekly Bulletin carrying October 2026 remittances

calls.statement: Kenya's total remittances for 2026 come in below 2025's
calls.measure: Cumulative remittance inflows for the 12 months to December 2026, % change on a year earlier, as the CBK Weekly Bulletin reports it
calls.check_source: CBK Weekly Bulletin carrying December 2026 remittances; CBK, Diaspora Remittances page

calls.statement: Money from North America for the whole of 2026 is down by more than 8% on 2025
calls.measure: North America inflows, January to December 2026 against January to December 2025, % change, CBK Diaspora Remittances table
calls.check_source: CBK, Diaspora Remittances page (monthly inflows by source)
